summary:
Here is a 3-sentence summary of the child's part of the interview:

The child has been attending speech therapy groups and sessions to discuss stuttering and has learned that it is a part of their identity that makes them special. They experience stuttering with more tension when in new or high-emotion situations, but find it easier to communicate fluently with people they know and trust. The child believes that stuttering cannot be cured, but rather requires support and understanding from others, and they value the role of speech therapists in providing emotional support and education to help them navigate stuttering.
